meta_desc: CV of Marco Antonio Adame Rodríguez, IoT and embedded systems engineer working on digital signal processing and structural health monitoring.
summary: I build end-to-end IoT systems: MEMS sensor, embedded firmware, real-time acquisition, signal processing, Linux backend, cloud and dashboards. I designed a low-cost structural health monitoring system from scratch and validated it in the field against commercial seismic instrumentation (GEA and P-Alert); the work led to three peer-reviewed papers and an international conference talk. I also build production geospatial web applications (Supabase, Leaflet, offline-first) with automated tests and continuous deployment. Computer Engineer and MSc graduate in Engineering for Innovation and Technological Development (UAGro), 9.42/10 GPA, degree conferral expected November 2026.

experience.intro: End-to-end design and implementation of a low-cost structural health monitoring solution for civil works, field-validated against commercial GEA and P-Alert equipment.

groups.name: Acquisition, firmware and hardware
items: Designed acquisition nodes on Arduino Nano RP2040 Connect and Raspberry Pi 4, integrating four MEMS sensors (MPU9250, MPU6050, LSM6DSOX and ADXL335) over I2C, SPI and UART.
Implemented synchronized 200 Hz acquisition across both RP2040 cores, with ample Nyquist margin for the structural frequency range of interest.

Validated the system in five environments — a biaxial shaking table, university buildings, a botanical garden, a high school campus and lightweight experimental structures — comparing its records against commercial GEA and P-Alert equipment.

groups.name: Signal processing and scientific software
items: Built a Python (NumPy/SciPy) DSP pipeline to identify the dynamic response of structures: RMS, FFT, power spectral density (Welch), dominant frequency, coherence, phase analysis and cross-correlation.
Developed PyQt5 desktop applications for acquisition, live monitoring and analysis, with session control and automatic crash recovery.
Built tools to process large TXT, CSV, JSON and JSONL record sets: time synchronization, resampling, gap detection, digital filtering and series trimming.
Automated the generation of technical reports and comparative plots against reference equipment; these results underpin my lead-author paper.

groups.name: Backend, cloud and infrastructure
items: Designed a centralized multi-site receiver over HTTP/HTTPS with local buffering, so connectivity outages do not cause data loss.
Developed REST APIs in FastAPI for ingesting, persisting and querying ESP32 node telemetry.
Administered continuously running Ubuntu servers: systemd services, Docker containers, SSH/VNC remote access, backups and synchronization.
Published web dashboards on Vercel to visualize, filter and download data from both custom nodes and commercial sensors in one place.

talk.label: Conference talk
talk.text: "Ambient Vibration Measurement System on a Biaxial Vibrating Table". 15th International Computing Conference (CICOM 2025), Tunja, Colombia, October 2025.

shm: Full architecture for acquisition, storage, analysis and visualization of accelerations in civil structures, field-tested against commercial sensors.
ecosistema: Web dashboard linking seismic hazard, soil, stations, acceleration maps, inspection and outreach on a single Supabase database. Computes routes to hospitals and emergency services over real streets (OpenStreetMap, Dijkstra) in five Baja California cities using the official CLUES health registry, works offline as an installable app, and ships with semantic versioning and automated tests on every change.
ivbc: Dashboard of 36 green-infrastructure techniques per municipality, with point queries over GeoJSON layers and address search, a login-protected editing panel, PDF and CSV reports, offline mode and a Supabase visit counter.
mortero: Web calculator for mortar mix design and strength, calibrated against the Mexico City Complementary Technical Standards (NTC-DECM). Works offline and installs as an app; bundling React and Tailwind into the project cut the download from 964 KB to 173 KB and load time on slow 4G from 7.8 s to 2 s, with headless Chrome tests.
prisma: Desktop application for PRISMA 2020 systematic reviews: merges exports from Scopus, Web of Science, IEEE and Lens (CSV, Excel and text), removes duplicates by similar titles, applies configurable automatic screening, guides manual review and generates the flow diagram.
shmsim: Next.js dashboard that simulates a network of GPS-georeferenced SHM sensors: location, status, battery and satellites per node, plus per-axis RMS and dominant frequency in real-time charts; ready to connect to Supabase or a custom API.
gps: Monitoring dashboard for the FCITEC-UABC network (SHM + P-Alert) over a simulated network of 9 campuses in Tijuana and 32 buildings in Guerrero, with soil-based site effects; computes RMS, PGA, spectrum and STA/LTA detection on the unified signal of three sensors.
supabase: Web application for submitting, querying and visualizing measurements stored in the cloud.
api: REST services for receiving, persisting and querying acceleration data, plus scientific plotting tools.
game: Tecnito & Greencito Squad — AI educational game
Turn-based game for primary and secondary school classes: two mascots chat through Claude to teach earthquake preparedness and environmental care. The API key stays in a serverless function.
trading: Educational desktop tool for technical and fundamental analysis, with cost-aware backtesting and walk-forward validation. Refactored a 4,363-line script into a modular architecture.
attendance: App for taking roll and generating attendance reports per class, with data in Supabase and automated tests for the core logic.
crm: Customer management web app for a jewelry business, deployed on Vercel.
cv: Bilingual Next.js and React site in TypeScript on Vercel (formerly PHP), generated from a single JSON data source, with a public JSON endpoint, a strict nonce-based Content Security Policy and automated tests on GitHub Actions. The same data generates PDF versions of the CV tailored to each job posting.
